_comment: #45 Phase 1 [D5] git-deny parity template for EPHEMERAL SPECIALIST worktree terminals. Octogent's native worktree mode has NO hard git deny (verified: apps/api/src/terminalRuntime/worktreeManager.ts + ptyEnvironment.ts inject no permission scoping) — the old :3001 engine enforced one via server/permission-scoping.ts buildDenyList(). Stage this file to $STATE/worktrees/<terminalId>/.claude/settings.json BEFORE the specialist starts editing (see fleet/README.md § Specialist spawn recipe). DELTA vs the old engine: `git commit` is ALLOWED here because octogent-native workers commit per logical unit on their own octogent/<terminalId> branch (PLAYBOOK §3); the old engine committed on the worker's behalf. Push remains hard-denied in both worlds.
